environment.detail: Clean tested SHA 4f92b6e; Python 3.12.7, torch 2.10.0+cu128, CUDA 12.8, RTX 4090 SM89, native Muon and torch._scaled_mm; 24,077 MiB free before/after; sufficient disk; spec merged; no overlapping PR.

handover.detail: All required REP files present and hashed; exact T0011 validator passed. Evidence branch/PR, hosted CPU CI and issue #62 handover follow this validated package. No merge or closure.

implementation.detail: Scoped eight-file implementation enables FP8 + Muon, accurate policy metadata, strict optimizer parsing, per-step audit, pre-step loss/FP8/gradient checks, post-update master/optimizer-state guards before checkpoint write, separate evaluation audit and deterministic history. No threshold, format, topology or optimizer-math change.

limitations: Correctness and one descriptive synthetic epoch only; no convergence, scaling, language-quality, throughput or optimizer-superiority claim.
Three runs are not a full factorial design; BF16 AdamW is absent, so no interaction effect or statistical inference.
Per-step audits and repeated checkpoint I/O confound wall time; no speed claim.
Current per-tensor FP8 scaling only; no delayed/persistent scaling, MXFP8/NVFP4, FP8 optimizer state or FP8 output.
Some unused experts are not dispatched; coverage is recorded, not an all-expert claim.
Checkpoints are local-only and are not published; no tensors are committed.
